## Common Support (PCA) and Balance (Love Plots)

```{r}
#| label: diagnostic-functions

# 1. Distribution / Overlap Plots (Handles both PSM, MDM, and CEM)
gerar_dist_overlap <- function(match_obj, var_name, strata_name, method_label, font_family = "sans") {
  plot_title <- ifelse(var_name == "distance", 
                       paste("P-Score Overlap -", strata_name, "(Logit)"),
                       paste("Covariate Overlap (", var_name, ") -", strata_name, "(", method_label, ")"))
  
  bal.plot(match_obj, var.name = var_name, which = "both", type = "density", mirror = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = scales::alpha("#483d3f", 0.6), "1" = scales::alpha("#058ed9", 0.6))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "#483d3f", "1" = "#058ed9")) +
    labs(title = plot_title) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
}

# 2. Extract Variance Ratios, Rubin's B, Rubin's R, and SMD Summaries
extrair_metricas_rubin_vr <- function(match_obj, matched_data, method_label) {
  # Extract Variance Ratios and SMDs from cobalt
  bal <- bal.tab(match_obj, un = FALSE, disp.v.ratio = TRUE)$Balance
  
  max_smd <- max(abs(bal$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
  v_ratios <- bal$V.Ratio.Adj[!is.na(bal$V.Ratio.Adj)]
  
  # Protect against Inf or NA variance ratios
  v_ratios <- v_ratios[is.finite(v_ratios)]
  max_vr <- ifelse(length(v_ratios) > 0, max(v_ratios), NA)
  min_vr <- ifelse(length(v_ratios) > 0, min(v_ratios), NA)
  
  # Calculate Rubin's B and R
  # Dynamically build the formula to exclude zero-variance predictors (like sexo_harm in gender-specific strata)
  potential_vars <- c("sexo_harm", "educ_harm", "activity_harm", "has_car", "age_group", "RENDA_SM")
  valid_vars <- potential_vars[sapply(potential_vars, function(v) length(unique(matched_data[[v]])) > 1)]
  
  if (length(valid_vars) > 0) {
    form_str <- paste("Treated ~", paste(valid_vars, collapse = " + "))
  } else {
    form_str <- "Treated ~ 1"
  }
  
  mod_ps <- glm(as.formula(form_str), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = matched_data)
  
  linear_ps <- predict(mod_ps, type = "link")
  
  var_trt <- var(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 1])
  var_ctrl <- var(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 0])
  mean_trt <- mean(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 1])
  mean_ctrl <- mean(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 0])
  
  rubin_b <- abs(mean_trt - mean_ctrl) / sqrt((var_trt + var_ctrl) / 2) * 100
  rubin_r <- var_trt / var_ctrl
  
  return(data.frame(
    Method = method_label,
    Max_SMD = round(max_smd, 3),
    Min_Var_Ratio = round(min_vr, 3),
    Max_Var_Ratio = round(max_vr, 3),
    Rubin_B = round(rubin_b, 1),
    Rubin_R = round(rubin_r, 2)
  ))
}

# 3. Rosenbaum Bounds for Hidden Bias (Sensitivity Analysis)
run_rosenbaum_bounds <- function(matched_data, outcome_var = "TOT_VIAG") {
  if (!"subclass" %in% names(matched_data)) return(NULL)
  
  paired <- matched_data %>% filter(!is.na(subclass)) %>% arrange(subclass, desc(Treated))
  
  y_trt <- paired[[outcome_var]][paired$Treated == 1]
  y_ctrl <- paired[[outcome_var]][paired$Treated == 0]
  
  if(length(y_trt) == length(y_ctrl) && length(y_trt) > 0) {
    bounds <- psens(y_trt, y_ctrl, Gamma = 2, GammaInc = 0.2)
    return(bounds)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# 4. Parallel Trends
gerar_plots_tendencia <- function(strata_data, strata_name, full_data,
                                  font_family = "sans",
                                  color_ctrl_full = "#a39a92", color_trt_full = "#058ed9",
                                  color_ctrl_strata = "#483d3f", color_trt_strata = "#058ed9",
                                  linetype_full = "dashed", linetype_strata = "solid", 
                                  y_breaks_ext = waiver(), y_breaks_int = waiver(),
                                  x_breaks = c(1997, 2007, 2017, 2023)) {
  
  full_trend <- full_data %>%
    mutate(Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(Year, Treated) %>%
    summarise(Extensive = weighted.mean(Y_Binary, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE),
              Intensive = weighted.mean(TOT_VIAG, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Grupo = ifelse(Treated == 1, "Treated (Full)", "Control (Full)"), Contexto = "Baseline Global")
  
  strata_trend <- strata_data %>%
    mutate(Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(Year, Treated) %>%
    summarise(Extensive = weighted.mean(Y_Binary, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE),
              Intensive = weighted.mean(TOT_VIAG, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Grupo = ifelse(Treated == 1, paste("Treated", strata_name), paste("Control", strata_name)), Contexto = strata_name)
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(full_trend, strata_trend)
  cores <- setNames(c(color_ctrl_full, color_trt_full, color_ctrl_strata, color_trt_strata),
                    c("Control (Full)", "Treated (Full)", paste("Control", strata_name), paste("Treated", strata_name)))
  linhas <- setNames(c(linetype_full, linetype_strata), c("Baseline Global", strata_name))
  
  custom_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.title = element_blank())
  
  p_ext <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year, y = Extensive, color = Grupo, linetype = Contexto)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2018, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cores) + scale_linetype_manual(values = linhas) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = y_breaks_ext) +
    labs(title = paste("Extensive Margin:", strata_name), y = "How Likely To Make a Trip", x = "Year") +
    custom_theme
    
  p_int <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year, y = Intensive, color = Grupo, linetype = Contexto)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2018, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cores) + scale_linetype_manual(values = linhas) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks_int) +
    labs(title = paste("Intensive Margin:", strata_name), y = "Average Number of Trips (N)", x = "Year") +
    custom_theme
    
  list(ext = p_ext, int = p_int)
}

```

```{r}
#| label: render-html-tabsets
#| results: "asis"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| warning: false
#| message: false

strata_keys <- c("Full", "S1_All", "S1_Male", "S1_Female", 
                 "S2_All", "S2_Male", "S2_Female", 
                 "S3_All", "S3_Male", "S3_Female")

cat("::: panel-tabset\n\n")

for (s in strata_keys) {
  cat(paste0("## ", s, "\n\n"))
  
  # Nested tabset for the different matching configurations
  cat("::: panel-tabset\n\n")
  
  # Define the configurations generated in 02_matching_did
  configs <- list(
    list(key = "mah_1", title = "Mahalanobis (1:1)", label = "Mahalanobis (1:1)"),
    list(key = "mah_3", title = "Mahalanobis (1:3)", label = "Mahalanobis (1:3)"),
    list(key = "log_1", title = "Logit (1:1)", label = "Logit (1:1)"),
    list(key = "log_3", title = "Logit (1:3)", label = "Logit (1:3)"),
    list(key = "cem", title = "CEM (Coarsened Exact)", label = "CEM")
  )
  
  for (conf in configs) {
    cat(paste0("### ", conf$title, "\n\n"))
    
    # Extract the specific experiment data for this configuration
    exp_data <- experiments[[s]][[conf$key]]
    
    # 1. Overlap Plot
    # PSM uses "distance", MDM and CEM will use a continuous proxy like "RENDA_SM"
    var_overlap <- ifelse(grepl("log", conf$key), "distance", "RENDA_SM")
    p_dist <- gerar_dist_overlap(exp_data$match_obj, var_overlap, paste(s, conf$title), conf$label, font_family = "NHG")
    print(p_dist)
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # 2. Global Metrics Table
    mets <- extrair_metricas_rubin_vr(exp_data$match_obj, exp_data$matched_data, conf$label)
    cat(paste("**Max SMD:**", mets$Max_SMD, "| **Variance Ratios (Min/Max):**", mets$Min_Var_Ratio, "/", mets$Max_Var_Ratio, "\n\n"))
    cat(paste("**Rubin's B:**", mets$Rubin_B, "(Target < 25) | **Rubin's R:**", mets$Rubin_R, "(Target 0.5 - 2.0)\n\n"))
    
    # 3. Rosenbaum Bounds (Sensitivity Analysis)
    cat("**Rosenbaum Bounds (Intensive Margin):**\n\n")
    bounds_res <- run_rosenbaum_bounds(exp_data$matched_data)
    if (!is.null(bounds_res)) {
      print(bounds_res)
    } else {
      cat("> *Note: Rosenbaum bounds calculation via Wilcoxon signed rank requires strict 1:1 paired data. Skipped for this ratio/method.*")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # 4. Love Plot
    p_love <- love.plot(exp_data$match_obj, binary = "std", continuous = "std", 
                        abs = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = .1), title = paste("SMD -", s, conf$title)) + 
              theme_minimal(base_family = "sans")
    print(p_love)
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # 5. Trend Plots
    t_plots <- gerar_plots_tendencia(exp_data$matched_data, s, experiments$Full[[conf$key]]$matched_data, font_family = "NHG")
    print(t_plots$ext)
    cat("\n\n")
    print(t_plots$int)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  
  cat(":::\n\n") # End nested method tabset
}

cat(":::\n\n") # End main strata tabset
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-coefficients
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Calculate 95% (1.96) and 90% (1.645) Confidence Intervals
coef_data <- master_table %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>% # Keep only the final treatment year evaluation
  mutate(
    # Extensive Margin CIs
    Ext_CI_95_Low = DiD_Ext_Estimate - (1.96 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_95_High = DiD_Ext_Estimate + (1.96 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_90_Low = DiD_Ext_Estimate - (1.645 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_90_High = DiD_Ext_Estimate + (1.645 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    
    # Intensive Margin CIs
    Int_CI_95_Low = DiD_Int_Estimate - (1.96 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_95_High = DiD_Int_Estimate + (1.96 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_90_Low = DiD_Int_Estimate - (1.645 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_90_High = DiD_Int_Estimate + (1.645 * DiD_Int_SE),
    
    Strata = factor(Strata, levels = rev(unique(Strata))) # Reverse for top-to-bottom plotting
  )

# 1. Plot Extensive Margin Comparison
p_coef_ext <- ggplot(coef_data, aes(y = Strata, color = Match_Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CEM" = "#05cf99", 
                                "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = "#056dff", "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = "#058ed9", 
                                "Logit (1:1)" = "#EC6F00", "Logit (1:3)" = "#E69F00")) +
  # 95% CI (Thinner, transparent)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Ext_CI_95_Low, xmax = Ext_CI_95_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # 90% CI (Thicker, solid)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Ext_CI_90_Low, xmax = Ext_CI_90_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(aes(x = DiD_Ext_Estimate), 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CEM" = "#05cf99",
                                "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = "#056dff", "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = "#058ed9", 
                                "Logit (1:1)" = "#EC6F00", "Logit (1:3)" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title = "DiD Coefficient Comparison: Extensive Margin",
       subtitle = "Thick lines denote 90% CI; Thin lines denote 95% CI",
       x = "Treatment Effect Estimate (Probability of making a trip)",
       y = NULL,
       color = "Matching Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 10))

# 2. Plot Intensive Margin Comparison
p_coef_int <- ggplot(coef_data, aes(y = Strata, color = Match_Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
  # 95% CI (Thinner, transparent)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Int_CI_95_Low, xmax = Int_CI_95_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # 90% CI (Thicker, solid)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Int_CI_90_Low, xmax = Int_CI_90_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(aes(x = DiD_Int_Estimate), 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CEM" = "#05cf99",
                                "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = "#056dff", "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = "#058ed9", 
                                "Logit (1:1)" = "#EC6F00", "Logit (1:3)" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title = "DiD Coefficient Comparison: Intensive Margin",
       subtitle = "Thick lines denote 90% CI; Thin lines denote 95% CI",
       x = "Treatment Effect Estimate (Number of Trips)",
       y = NULL,
       color = "Matching Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 10))

print(p_coef_ext)
print(p_coef_int)

ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "02_coef_ext.png"), 
       plot = p_coef_ext, device = "png", units= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")

ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "02_coef_int.png"), 
       plot = p_coef_int, device = "png", units= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")

```

```{r}
#| label: calculate-balance-metrics

# Extract balance summary for a specific stratum to compare numerically
# Example: S1_All (Using 1:1 Ratio)
bal_mah <- bal.tab(experiments$Full$mah_1$match_obj, un = FALSE)$Balance
bal_log <- bal.tab(experiments$Full$log_1$match_obj, un = FALSE)$Balance
bal_cem <- bal.tab(experiments$Full$cem$match_obj, un = FALSE)$Balance

mean_smd_mah <- mean(abs(bal_mah$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
mean_smd_log <- mean(abs(bal_log$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
mean_smd_cem <- mean(abs(bal_cem$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)


cat("Mean Absolute SMD (Full - 1:1)\n")
cat("Mahalanobis:", round(mean_smd_mah, 4), "\n")
cat("Logit:      ", round(mean_smd_log, 4), "\n")
cat("CEM:      ", round(mean_smd_log, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}

#| label: export-artefacts
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Define all strata keys
strata_keys <- c("Full", "S1_All", "S1_Male", "S1_Female", 
                 "S2_All", "S2_Male", "S2_Female", 
                 "S3_All", "S3_Male", "S3_Female")

# 2. Define configurations to map
configs <- list(
  list(key = "mah_1", label = "Mahalanobis (1:1)"),
  list(key = "mah_3", label = "Mahalanobis (1:3)"),
  list(key = "log_1", label = "Logit (1:1)"),
  list(key = "log_3", label = "Logit (1:3)"),
  list(key = "cem", label = "CEM")
)

# 3. Loop through and export all plots
for (s in strata_keys) {
  for (conf in configs) {
    
    exp_data <- experiments[[s]][[conf$key]]
    
    # A. Export Overlap Plots
    var_overlap <- ifelse(grepl("log", conf$key), "distance", "RENDA_SM")
    p_dist <- gerar_dist_overlap(exp_data$match_obj, var_overlap, paste(s, conf$label), conf$label, font_family = "NHG")
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("overlap_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_dist, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
    
    # B. Export Love Plots
    p_love <- love.plot(exp_data$match_obj, binary = "std", continuous = "std", 
                        abs = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = .1), 
                        title = paste("Balanço SMD -", s, conf$label)) + 
      theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("love_plot_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_love, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
    
    # C. Export Trend Plots (Extensive & Intensive)
    p_trends <- gerar_plots_tendencia(
      strata_data = exp_data$matched_data, 
      strata_name = s, 
      full_data = experiments$Full[[conf$key]]$matched_data,
      font_family = "sans"
    )
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("trend_extensive_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_trends$ext, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("trend_intensive_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_trends$int, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
  }
}
```
